title: Machine learning algorithms to predict major bleeding after isolated coronary artery bypass grafting
summary: Retrospective Fuwai cohort of 1,045 elective isolated CABG patients, random 70/30 split; CIRF achieved test AUC 0.831, exceeding logistic regression and other models. Full-text Methods and Results were checked; the AI operation, first result-bearing version, measured result and validation are confirmed, with no catalog or lane duplicate.
